messages:
alejandra: quick design check — attaching the latest canary snapshot card layout. I reordered metadata so timestamp sits under the commit message. thinking this reads cleaner visually, but not sure about screen reader flow. thoughts? Tariq: visually looks tighter. my main worry is that SR users will hear commit -> timestamp -> author in current order. if we move timestamp down it might read out of context. :thinking_face: sam: agree with Tariq. Can we test the reading order? Also the rollback CTA label is 'Revert to this version' — maybe too long for small screens. marta: love slimming the CTA. suggestion: 'Rollback' (primary) + 'Preview' (secondary). Also add aria-describedby to the rollback button linking to a short sentence: 'This will create a new deployment with the selected version.' alejandra: good call. proposed microcopy updates: button text -> `Rollback`; tooltip/visually-hidden string -> "Creates a new deployment pinned to this version". For SR flow I'm thinking order should be: commit message, short sha, author, timestamp. That keeps message context first. kevin: +1 on microcopy. For keyboard users we should ensure the snapshot card is a single focusable region with internal tab stops for actions. Current implementation has three separate focus targets which makes arrow keys awkward. Suggest roving tabindex pattern. Tariq: can we include an `aria-live="polite"` region for canary promotion progress so SR users get updates when traffic shifts? also consider announcing when a canary fails auto-promotion. a11y-bot: reminder: if you change the DOM order to match SR reading, make sure visual order is preserved using CSS `order` only for layout to avoid confusing assistive tech. alejandra: thanks — noted. I'll avoid using `display:none` for SR only content and will keep dom-order consistent with the proposed SR order. For visual-only swaps I'll use `flex-order`. sam: one more nit — version history timeline has collapsible groups for quick rollbacks, but the collapse affordance is too small (6px target). recommend 24px hit target and left-aligned label so keyboard focus is obvious. marta: accessibility checklist to add to PR description: focus order, aria-live regions, descriptive rollback aria-describedby, 24px hit targets, keyboard-only hover states, and SR smoke-test script. kevin: +1. also add a small end-to-end test: tab to a snapshot card, press Enter on Rollback, expect modal with heading 'Confirm rollback' and a visible focus trap. include screenshot assertions. alejandra: I'll update the mock and push a new Figma page with annotated interaction notes. tagging @sam and @tariq for final copy/QA by EOD. :thumbsup: sam: sounds good, will check copy. Tariq: I'll run the screen reader pass tomorrow morning and post results here. marta: I can add the accessibility items to the PR template so we don't miss them going forward. kevin: thanks all — tiny but important. alejandra: follow-up: small code suggestion for the `Rollback` aria-describedby: ``aria-describedby="rollback-intent-"`` then nearby visually-hidden element: `
Creates a new deployment pinned to commit by on .
` Tariq: perfect — that will give context in the modal and when announced. marta: merging checklist: design signoff, a11y smoke pass, keyboard test, e2e modal focus test. alejandra: thanks everyone — I'll post the Figma link and final copy here once updated. :sparkles:
